title: Models Are Getting Dumber on Purpose
summary:
The article argues that AI labs are deliberately making models “dumber” on factual knowledge in order to focus on reasoning, and that this trade-off is the intended design.

**Key points:**

- **Reasoning improves while parameter counts shrink.** Models like GLM-5.2, Qwen3.5, and DeepSeek V4-Flash score high on math/code benchmarks with far fewer active parameters than GPT-4-era models. Small models are especially strong at reasoning per parameter.

- **Factual recall has collapsed.** On SimpleQA, Gemini 2.5 Pro leads at only 53%. Small Qwen models hallucinate 80–82% of the time on knowledge benchmarks, inventing confident answers to factual questions.

- **Facts are expensive; reasoning is compressible.** Knowledge storage requires roughly two bits per parameter, while reasoning is a small set of reusable procedures. Training methods like distillation and RL on verifiable tasks transfer reasoning skills into small models efficiently. The result is broad, shallow generalists: they know a little about everything but little depth.

- **Facts rot; procedures don’t.** Knowledge-heavy models go stale quickly, while reasoning remains valid. If facts live outside the weights, the model doesn’t age as fast and its cutoff matters less.

- **The harness supplies knowledge.** Retrieval, web search, tools, and local files provide facts at runtime. Coding agents already work this way—they read documentation or grep code instead of relying on memory.

- **A local frontier model is plausible.** With knowledge stripped out, total model size could shrink toward active size, allowing high-quality reasoning on a single consumer GPU (20–40B parameters, 4-bit quantized). The catch: it won’t know much and must say “I don’t know” then look things up.

- **Hallucination becomes addressable.** Wrong facts in weights are unfindable; wrong facts in external sources can be traced, edited, and corrected for all future queries. Model cards might eventually stop listing knowledge cutoffs entirely.
chinese_title: 模型正故意变得更笨
chinese_summary:
本文认为，AI实验室正在故意让模型在事实性知识上变得“更笨”，以专注于推理能力，而这种取舍是预期设计使然。

**关键要点：**

- **推理能力提升，参数数量缩减。** GLM-5.2、Qwen3.5、DeepSeek V4-Flash等模型在数学/代码基准测试中得分很高，但活跃参数远少于GPT-4时代的模型。小模型在每参数推理能力上尤其突出。

- **事实性回忆能力崩塌。** 在SimpleQA基准上，Gemini 2.5 Pro以仅53%的准确率领先。小型Qwen模型在知识基准测试中80%至82%的时间都在产生幻觉，对事实性问题编造出自信的答案。

- **事实昂贵，推理可压缩。** 知识存储大约需要每个参数两比特，而推理只是一小组可复用的程序。蒸馏和基于可验证任务的强化学习等训练方法能高效地将推理技能迁移到小模型中。结果是涌现出广而浅的“通才”：什么都知道一点，但什么都不深。

- **事实会腐烂，程序不会。** 知识密集型的模型很快就会过时，而推理能力始终保持有效。如果事实存在于权重之外，模型就不会快速老化，其知识截止日期的影响也会变小。

- **外部框架提供知识。** 检索、网页搜索、工具和本地文件在运行时提供事实。编码智能体已经是这样运作的——它们阅读文档或使用grep搜索代码，而不是依赖记忆。

- **本地前沿模型是可行的。** 如果剥离知识，模型总大小可能收缩至接近活跃大小，从而在单张消费级GPU上实现高质量推理（200亿至400亿参数，4位量化）。代价是：它不会知道太多，必须说“我不知道”，然后去查阅。

- **幻觉问题变得可解决。** 权重中的错误事实无法被找到；而外部来源中的错误事实可以追踪、编辑，并在未来所有查询中得以纠正。模型卡最终可能完全不再列出知识截止日期。

title: Protobuf has LSP support. You're welcome
summary:
Buf announced the first production-grade Language Server Protocol (LSP) server for Protobuf, bringing modern IDE features like go-to-definition, code completion, references, and semantic highlighting to `.proto` files for the first time.

The LSP server is bundled with the Buf CLI. VSCode users can install the official Buf extension, which automatically uses the CLI. Neovim users can configure `lspconfig.buf_ls.setup {}` or add a manual `buf lsp serve` command. Other editors can run the same command to enable LSP support.

The server is built on Buf’s compiler frontend, protocompile, which is faster and more flexible than `protoc`. For the LSP, Buf developed a new query-driven frontend that supports incremental compilation and improved diagnostics, such as correctly identifying duplicate modifiers. A new AST and intermediate representation enables precise error reporting, better memory efficiency, and easier support for upcoming Protobuf features like Editions 2024.

Buf also outlined upcoming LSP features: automatic import fixes, tighter `buf.yaml` integration, completion and reference lookup for custom options, automatic field/enum number suggestions, and dedicated Protovalidate support with CEL syntax highlighting.

The announcement positions the LSP as part of Buf’s broader ecosystem—Protobuf-ES, Protovalidate, ConnectRPC, and the Buf Schema Registry—aimed at making Protobuf the easiest choice for schema-driven development.

title: The AI Credit Resale Economy
summary:
The article examines the emerging "token broker" economy, where middlemen buy unused AI credits from startups and resell them at steep discounts.

Author Matt Lenhard discovered this trend after founders reported receiving numerous unsolicited offers for discounted Anthropic tokens. Follow-up outreach to brokers revealed significant supply: one seller claimed access to $100k in daily spend, operating as a proxy that forwards requests from a pool of keys rather than handing over provider credentials.

The market operates across several channels. Dedicated credit marketplaces like AI Credits and AICreditMart list credits for major cloud and inference providers at 30–80% off, with formal seller onboarding. Another category, "bulk-discount routers" such as CheapCredits, Tokvana, and Neokens, claim their discounts come from bulk purchasing power—though the author finds a flat 40% discount implausible unless buying at massive enterprise scale, suspecting alternative supply acquisition methods. CheapCredits notably offers a Data Processing Agreement for GDPR compliance.

Underground channels are also active: Telegram groups, Reddit posts on r/saasforsale and r/indiehackers, and closed startup communities all host credit-swapping activity.

Lenhard estimates tens of millions of dollars in credits are currently offered across these venues. He warns that tokens have become a pseudo-currency with enough liquidity to enable significant abuse. As the market matures and companies focus more on costs, crackdowns on this kind of trading are likely imminent. The piece is a follow-up to his earlier investigation into the relay market powering token resellers and fraud, and sources include screenshots, direct outreach, and public site listings.
chinese_title: AI积分转售经济
chinese_summary:
文章探讨了新兴的“代币经纪人”经济，中间商从初创公司购买未使用的AI额度，并以大幅折扣转售。

作者马特·伦哈德在创业者们反馈收到大量主动提出的Anthropic代币折扣报价后，发现了这一趋势。随后对经纪人的跟进调查揭示了可观的供应量：一位卖家声称拥有每日10万美元的消费额度，通过代理方式运作——转发来自密钥池的请求，而非移交供应商凭据。

这一市场通过多种渠道运作。专门的信用额度市场平台如AI Credits和AICreditMart以三至八折的价格列出各大云服务及推理提供商的额度，并有正式的卖家入驻流程。另一类“批量折扣路由器”如CheapCredits、Tokvana和Neokens，声称其折扣来自批量采购能力——不过作者认为，除非以超大规模企业级别采购，否则固定四折的优惠难以令人信服，怀疑其供应获取方式另有门路。值得注意的是，CheapCredits提供了符合GDPR要求的数据处理协议。

地下渠道同样活跃：Telegram群组、Reddit上r/saasforsale和r/indiehackers版块的帖子，以及封闭的初创社区中都在进行额度互换活动。

伦哈德估计，目前这些渠道中流通的额度总价值达数千万美元。他警告称，代币已成为一种具有足够流动性的准货币，可能被大规模滥用。随着市场逐渐成熟，企业日益重视成本管控，对此类交易的打击很可能即将到来。这篇文章是他此前关于支撑代币转售商和欺诈行为的转售市场调查的后续报道，信息来源包括截图、直接联系访谈以及公开网站列表。

title: MathCode, Mathematical Coding Agent
summary:
MathCode is a terminal-based AI coding assistant designed for mathematical formalization. It takes math problems stated in plain language and automatically converts them into Lean 4 theorems, then attempts formal proofs. It includes a persistent Lean REPL for fast compile checks (~0.4s after warmup), a reusable theorem library of proved statements, and an axiom library for storing conversational assumptions as compile-checked Lean declarations.

The assistant integrates with Lean’s ecosystem by searching leansearch.net and Loogle for Mathlib lemmas and using LSP diagnostics for repairs. It also generates an Obsidian vault that visualizes theorem dependencies as a knowledge graph. In agent mode, proofs become interactive sessions where the model iteratively writes candidates, reads errors, and recompiles. A tree-of-subgoals feature decomposes complex theorems into independent subgoals proven in parallel and then stitched together. Multi-planner runs multiple planning strategies concurrently to select the best proof approach.

Quick start requires macOS (arm64) or Linux (x86_64), the Codex CLI for the default backend, and running `bash setup.sh` followed by `codex auth login` and `mathcode`. Outputs are written to `LeanFormalizations/`, and a browser UI is available via `./run webui`. The project is based on the AUTOLEAN pipeline and can be cited via the provided BibTeX entry.

该助手通过搜索leansearch.net和Loogle集成Lean生态系统，查找Mathlib引理，并使用LSP诊断进行修复。它还生成一个Obsidian仓库，将定理依赖关系可视化为知识图谱。在代理模式中，证明变为交互式会话，模型在其中迭代地编写候选、读取错误并重新编译。子目标树功能将复杂定理分解为独立的子目标，并行证明后再拼接在一起。多规划器并发运行多种规划策略，以选择最佳的证明方法。

title: NIH is ending a key grant for budding clinical researchers
summary:
According to Science.org, the NIH’s National Center for Advancing Translational Sciences (NCATS) is phasing out the KL2 career development grant, a key component of the Clinical and Translational Science Awards (CTSA) program. KL2 awards provide salary support, research funding, and mentorship for early-career clinical and translational researchers at academic medical centers across the United States.

Under the change, current KL2 awards will be allowed to continue until they expire, but NCATS will no longer accept new applications. The agency says the shift is part of a broader restructuring of the CTSA program to make funding more flexible and sustainable, and to prioritize translational science initiatives.

The decision has raised concerns among researchers and CTSA leaders. They worry that cutting the KL2 grant will weaken the pipeline of budding clinical investigators, reduce opportunities for protected research time and mentorship, and worsen existing challenges facing early-career physician-scientists. NCATS, however, maintains that it is working to reallocate resources in ways that will still support a diverse next generation of clinical researchers.

根据这一变化，现有的KL2资助将允许继续直至到期，但NCATS将不再接受新的申请。该机构表示，这一转变是CTSA项目更广泛重组的一部分，旨在使资金更加灵活和可持续，并优先支持转化科学计划。

这一决定引起了研究人员和CTSA负责人的担忧。他们担心取消KL2资助将削弱 budding 临床研究者的培养管道，减少受保护的研究时间和导师指导机会，并加剧早期医师科学家面临的现有挑战。然而，NCATS坚称，其正在努力以仍将支持多元化的下一代临床研究者的方式重新分配资源。

title: St Lucie Nuclear Reactor Unit 1 manually shutdown, 3 control rods drop into core
summary: A manual shutdown occurred at Unit 1 of the St. Lucie Nuclear Power Plant on Wednesday morning after three control rods dropped into the reactor core. The reactor was manually tripped at 9:47 a.m. EDT on Aug. 13, 2026, while operating at 100% power. The Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) classified the event as a non-emergency. According to the licensee, the trip was uncomplicated, with all systems responding normally. Operations stabilized the plant in Mode 3 (Hot Standby), and decay heat is being removed by discharging steam to the main condenser using turbine bypass valves and main feedwater. Unit 2 was not affected. As of the report, Unit 1 remains shut down.

title: Anton Chekhov played at love most of his life
summary:
Anton Chekhov was long portrayed—by both Soviet and Western critics—as a saintly, ascetic figure devoted only to medicine and literature. Newer scholarship, especially Donald Rayfield’s 1997 biography, challenges this image, revealing a “red-blooded, Don Juanish” man with many affairs and complicated relationships.

The article examines Chekhov’s marriage to actress Olga Knipper, which began only three years before his death and was conducted largely through letters across great distances. Their correspondence shows affection and dependence, but also emotional distance, a father-daughter dynamic, and frequent misunderstandings. Readers’ hopes for a true late-life love remain ambiguous.

The central controversy involves a 1902 pregnancy loss. Olga said she had a miscarriage requiring surgery and recovery. Rayfield instead claims it was an ectopic pregnancy that had to be aborted, and calculates Chekhov could not have been the father given he was hundreds of miles away at conception. Rayfield sees Chekhov’s departure for the Urals while Olga recovered as evidence of a grievance; scholar Hugh McLean defends Olga’s account and attacks Rayfield’s diagnosis.

The article also notes Chekhov’s death: he died in 1904 in Germany, after famously drinking champagne and saying, “I’ve been a long time since I’ve had champagne.” Olga outlived him by 55 years. Ultimately, the essay questions whether flattening Chekhov’s full humanity—especially his sexual and emotional complexity—distorts understanding of his life and art.
chinese_title: 安东·契诃夫一生大部分时间都在把爱情当作游戏。
chinese_summary:
安东·契诃夫长期以来被苏联和西方评论家描绘成一个圣洁、禁欲的形象，只专注于医学和文学。但较新的学术研究，尤其是唐纳德·雷菲尔德1997年出版的传记，挑战了这一形象，揭示了一个“血气方刚、唐璜式”的男人，他情事众多，关系复杂。

文章考察了契诃夫与女演员奥尔加·克尼佩尔的婚姻。这段婚姻在他去世前三年才开始，大部分时间依靠相隔千里的书信维系。他们的通信显示出深情与依赖，但也流露出情感上的疏离、父女式的互动模式，以及频繁的误解。读者对他们晚年真爱的期许仍然暧昧不明。

核心争议涉及1902年的一次流产。奥尔加称自己当时流产，需要手术并休养。雷菲尔德则声称那是宫外孕，必须终止妊娠，并推算契诃夫不可能是孩子的父亲，因为在受孕时间点上他远在数百英里之外。雷菲尔德认为契诃夫在奥尔加休养期间前往乌拉尔山是心怀不满的证据；学者休·麦克莱恩则为奥尔加的说法辩护，并抨击了雷菲尔德的诊断。

文章还提到了契诃夫的去世：他于1904年在德国辞世，临终前著名地喝了香槟，并说：“我已经很久没喝香槟了。”奥尔加比他多活了55年。归根结底，这篇文章质疑的是，将契诃夫完整的人性——尤其是他性与情感方面的复杂性——加以扁平化，是否会扭曲对他生平与艺术的理解。

title: Clamiga: Common Lisp for the Amiga
summary:
Clamiga is a Common Lisp implementation built for classic AmigaOS 3 on 68k, MorphOS as a native PowerPC build, plus macOS and Linux for development. Its name plays on “CL-Amiga” and “amiga” meaning friend.

It uses a portable C core with a stack-based bytecode VM, tagged 32-bit values, and a compacting GC. This keeps memory usage small: the full Common Lisp core boots in about 0.5 MB, and simple programs can run with a 1 MB heap. Packed byte vectors and bulk sequence I/O help on constrained 68k machines. Architecture-agnostic FASL files are byte-compatible between m68k and PPC.

On AmigaOS 68020+, Clamiga includes an m68k JIT that translates bytecode to native code at definition time, giving large speedups on compute-heavy code while falling back to the interpreter for unsupported instructions. The MorphOS build omits the JIT but runs the VM fast enough for practical Quicklisp use. Quicklisp is supported through a compatibility layer, with libraries like Alexandria, FiveAM, FSet, str, Drakma, and Hunchentoot confirmed working.

Clamiga also ships bindings for Intuition, Graphics, and GadTools for native Amiga GUI programming, plus raw library-call trampolines. It provides a REPL, inspector, debugger, conditions, restarts, CLOS, the full numeric tower, sockets, threads, file I/O, and an ASDF-compatible build system.
chinese_title: Clamiga：Amiga平台上的Common Lisp
chinese_summary:
Clamiga 是一个 Common Lisp 实现，专为 68k 上的经典 AmigaOS 3 构建，MorphOS 则作为原生 PowerPC 构建，另外还支持 macOS 和 Linux 用于开发。其名称取自“CL-Amiga”与“amiga”（意为“朋友”）的双关。

它使用可移植的 C 核心，配以基于栈的字节码虚拟机、带标签的 32 位值和压缩式垃圾回收器。这使其内存占用很小：完整的 Common Lisp 核心启动仅需约 0.5 MB，简单程序可在 1 MB 堆上运行。紧凑字节向量和批量序列 I/O 有助于在资源受限的 68k 机器上运行。与架构无关的 FASL 文件在 m68k 和 PPC 之间字节兼容。

在 AmigaOS 68020+ 上，Clamiga 包含一个 m68k JIT，在定义时将字节码翻译为原生代码，大幅加速计算密集型代码，同时对不支持的指令回退到解释器。MorphOS 版本省略了 JIT，但虚拟机运行速度足够快，可实际用于 Quicklisp。通过兼容层支持 Quicklisp，已确认可运行 Alexandria、FiveAM、FSet、str、Drakma 和 Hunchentoot 等库。

title: Low-Tech Ceramic Water Filter
summary:
The article describes a low-tech ceramic water filter designed for sustainable and accessible water purification. It emphasizes local production using simple materials and methods, aligning with low-tech principles: durability, repairability, and minimal environmental impact.

The filter is made from a mixture of clay and combustible organic material (like sawdust or rice husks). This mixture is shaped into a pot or candle, fired in a kiln, and the organic matter burns away, leaving a porous ceramic structure. These pores physically remove pathogens, bacteria, and suspended particles. Optionally, the ceramic is coated with colloidal silver, which acts as a disinfectant and prevents bacterial growth.

The system works by gravity: contaminated water is poured into a container above the ceramic filter, slowly passing through the tiny pores, and clean water is collected below. It requires no electricity or complex machinery, making it ideal for rural and off-grid communities.

The article also covers key practical aspects: the filter's low production cost, the use of local materials, and the possibility of manufacturing it at a small scale. It highlights simplicity of use and maintenance—regular cleaning of the ceramic surface is needed, and the filter can last for years if handled properly. Testing shows high effectiveness in removing microbial contamination, significantly improving water safety.

Overall, the page presents a practical, open-source solution for clean drinking water that can be built and repaired by local communities, reducing dependency on high-tech, centralized systems. It aligns with the Low-tech Lab's mission to share accessible technologies that respect both people and the planet.
chinese_title: 低成本陶瓷净水器

该过滤器由黏土与可燃有机材料（如木屑或稻壳）的混合物制成。将混合物塑造成盆状或烛状，在窑中烧制，有机物质燃烧殆尽后，留下多孔的陶瓷结构。这些微孔可物理去除病原体、细菌和悬浮颗粒。可选地，陶瓷表面会涂覆一层胶体银，起到消毒作用并防止细菌滋生。

该系统依靠重力工作：将受污染的水倒入陶瓷过滤器上方的容器中，水缓慢穿过微小孔隙，干净的水在下方收集。它不需要电力或复杂的机械设备，非常适合农村和离网社区使用。

文章还涵盖了关键的实际方面：过滤器的生产成本低、使用本地材料，以及可以小规模制造的可能性。文章强调了使用和维护的简便性——需要定期清洁陶瓷表面，如果妥善使用，过滤器可以使用数年。测试表明，它在去除微生物污染方面效果显著，大大提高了水的安全性。

总体而言，该页面提出了一种实用、开源的安全饮用水解决方案，可由当地社区自行制造和修理，减少对高技术、集中式系统的依赖。这与低技术实验室的使命相一致，即分享既尊重人类又尊重地球的可及技术。

title: The weekend is 100 years old
summary:
The article marks the 100th anniversary of the two-day weekend, introduced by Henry Ford in 1926 when he gave factory workers five eight-hour days with no pay cut. Ford wasn't the inventor—trade unions and reformers had campaigned for it—but he made it industrial standard. The article cites the Soviet Union's 1929–1940 experiment without weekends, which failed because workers lost shared leisure time and morale collapsed.

The weekend became established in the UK gradually: Boots adopted a five-day week in 1933, and the full two-day weekend became widespread after World War II. It transformed society, creating rituals from Saturday football to Sunday roasts and later the minibreak. Sunday lost much of its religious character after the Sunday Trading Act 1994 allowed large shops to open.

Today, the weekend is being reshaped by hybrid working. Friday has become an informal “Skiveday,” with remote workers doing little; rail companies now treat Fridays as off-peak. The workforce is split between “time owners” who control their hours and “time slaves” tied to shifts or gig work. Meanwhile, emails and contactability erode Saturday and Sunday themselves.

The article also covers the four-day week debate. Pilot schemes report higher revenue and retention, and 260 UK companies have adopted it, but politicians are divided—some call it wasteful. Ultimately, the weekend remains central to autonomy and shared community time, though its boundaries are blurring and its future uncertain.
chinese_title: 周末已有100年历史
chinese_summary:
这篇文章是为了纪念双休日制度诞生100周年。1926年，亨利·福特为工厂工人实行了每天8小时、每周5天的工作制，且工资不减。福特并非该制度的发明者——工会和改革者早已为此奔走呼吁——但他使其成为了工业标准。文章提到，苏联在1929年至1940年间曾试行无周末制度，但以失败告终，原因是工人失去了共同的休闲时间，士气低落。

周末在英国是逐步确立的：博姿公司于1933年实行五天工作制，而完整的双休日则在二战后广泛普及。周末深刻改变了社会，催生了从周六足球赛到周日烤肉大餐，再到后来的短途度假等种种惯例。1994年《周日交易法》允许大型商店在周日营业后，周日逐渐丧失了其宗教色彩。

如今，周末正被混合办公模式重塑。周五已成为非正式的“偷闲日”，远程办公者几乎不怎么干活；铁路公司现在也将周五视为非高峰时段。职场人士分裂为两类：一类是能掌控自己时间的“时间主人”，另一类是被轮班或零工经济绑定的“时间奴隶”。与此同时，电子邮件和随时可联系的状态正在侵蚀周六和周日本身。

文章还探讨了四天工作制的争论。试点项目报告显示收入和员工留存率均有提升，英国已有260家公司 adopt 了该制度，但政界人士意见分歧——有人称之为浪费。归根结底，周末对于个人自主权和共享社区时间仍然至关重要，尽管其边界正在模糊，未来也充满不确定性。

title: A True Telnet BBS on a Casio Calculator
summary:
The article describes how amateur radio operator EI3LH developed a true telnet Bulletin Board System (BBS) hosted entirely on a Casio VX-4 pocket calculator. Initially uninterested in calculators, the author became fascinated after discovering the device's BASIC programming and RS232 serial port capabilities. He acquired a VX-4 with a 32KB RAM expander and an FTDI RS232-to-USB-C cable.

The core project was creating a BBS that runs on the calculator's baseline 8KB RAM. A Raspberry Pi Zero W serves as a bridge to the internet, providing connectivity and an optional message archive vault, but all BBS logic and message storage reside on the calculator. Access is currently invite-only via Tailscale for security.

The BBS software, written in BASIC, puts the VX-4's COM port in listening mode. Callers connect via telnet, enter their amateur radio callsign, and receive a four-option menu: read messages, write a message (limited to 60 characters), view an about page, or disconnect. Due to the calculator's limited processing power and 4800-baud serial reliability, the BBS supports only one connection at a time.

The author also added an OLED HAT to the Pi for status display and demonstrated the working system by connecting over 5G cellular. Future plans include publishing the code to GitHub, possibly migrating to C, and adding more features within RAM constraints. The article concludes with the author's enthusiasm for experimenting with vintage technology, focused on learning, sharing, and fun.
chinese_title: 卡西欧计算器上的真正Telnet BBS
chinese_summary:
这篇文章讲述了业余无线电操作员EI3LH如何开发了一个真正的远程登录公告板系统（BBS），该系统完全托管在卡西欧VX-4袖珍计算器上。作者起初对计算器并不感兴趣，但在发现该设备的BASIC编程和RS232串口功能后，便为之着迷。他购入了一台配备32KB内存扩展卡的VX-4，以及一根FTDI RS232转USB-C线缆。

该项目的核心是在计算器基线8KB内存上运行一个BBS系统。一台树莓派Zero W作为连接互联网的桥梁，提供网络连接和可选的消息存档库，但所有BBS逻辑和消息存储都驻留在计算器上。出于安全考虑，目前仅通过Tailscale邀请制访问。

这款用BASIC编写的BBS软件将VX-4的COM端口置于监听模式。呼叫者通过telnet连接，输入自己的业余无线电呼号，然后看到一个包含四个选项的菜单：读取消息、写消息（限制为60个字符）、查看关于页面或断开连接。由于计算器处理能力有限且4800波特串行通信的可靠性限制，BBS仅支持单连接。

作者还为树莓派添加了一个OLED扩展板用于状态显示，并通过5G蜂窝网络连接演示了系统的运行。未来的计划包括将代码发布到GitHub，可能迁移到C语言，并在内存限制内添加更多功能。文章最后表达了作者对尝试复古技术的热情，专注于学习、分享和乐趣。

title: Before Rightmove, there was the Cosmorama
summary:
A London estate agency, Brooks and Green of Old Bond Street, used a Victorian visual technology called the cosmorama to market luxury properties in the 1840s and 1850s, more than 160 years before online listings and virtual tours.

According to research led by Professor John Plunkett of the University of Exeter, the firm offered prospective buyers immersive views of houses and country estates through convex lenses that enlarged specially commissioned illustrations and created an illusion of depth. With controlled lighting, the displays gave an “aerial perspective” of both the house and its grounds.

The cosmorama had previously been seen as a form of entertainment, but the study reveals its commercial use in property marketing. Plunkett catalogued over 650 documented cosmoramas across Portugal, Spain and the UK, as well as others in the Americas and Australia.

Newspaper advertisements show that Brooks and Hedger – later renamed Brooks and Green – began offering these property views from the late 1830s, with ads continuing until at least 1859, claiming “several hundred views of different estates.”

Each image required an artist to visit the property and produce a detailed illustration, making the process expensive and likely restricted to prestigious homes. Plunkett said the discovery shows how estate agents were developing more sophisticated marketing techniques as Britain’s property market professionalised, fuelled by population growth, urbanisation and better transport.

He described the practise as a pioneering “virtual tour” over 150 years before digital technology realised its full potential. The research was published in *Early Popular Visual Culture*.
chinese_title: 在Rightmove之前，是Cosmorama的时代
chinese_summary:
一家位于老邦德街的伦敦房地产中介公司——布鲁克斯与格林公司，在19世纪40年代和50年代使用一种名为“西洋景”的维多利亚时代视觉技术来营销豪华房产，比在线房源和虚拟看房早了160多年。

根据埃克塞特大学约翰·普兰克特教授主导的研究，该公司通过凸透镜为潜在购房者提供房屋和乡村庄园的沉浸式景观，这些凸透镜放大了特制的插图并营造出景深错觉。通过受控照明，这些展示为房屋及其庭园提供了“空中透视”效果。

西洋景此前一直被视作一种娱乐形式，但该研究揭示了其在房产营销中的商业用途。普兰克特在葡萄牙、西班牙和英国记录了650多件有文献记载的西洋景，此外在美洲和澳大利亚也有其他发现。

报纸广告显示，布鲁克斯与赫奇公司——后更名为布鲁克斯与格林公司——从19世纪30年代末开始提供这些房产景观服务，广告一直持续到至少1859年，声称拥有“数百处不同庄园的景观”。

每幅图像都需要艺术家前往房产所在地绘制精细插图，这使得该过程成本高昂，可能仅限于高端住宅。普兰克特表示，这一发现表明，在人口增长、城市化和交通改善的推动下，随着英国房地产市场日益专业化，房地产中介正在开发更成熟的营销技术。

他将这种做法描述为一种开创性的“虚拟看房”，比数字技术充分发挥其潜力早了150多年。该研究发表在《早期流行视觉文化》期刊上。

title: Chestnut – eGPU dock with open-source firmware
summary:
Comma.ai has released the Chestnut, an eGPU dock with open-source firmware, primarily designed to run larger driving models in cars. Two versions are available: the Tiny Chestnut at $249 (dock only) and the Chestnut "ready to drive" at $799, which includes an AMD Radeon RX 9060 8GB, cabling, and mounting hardware. The dock raises the compute power from comma’s usual ~10W budget to ~100W, allowing a desktop GPU to be used with a comma four device, and is claimed to match Tesla’s HW4 performance. It accompanies openpilot 0.11.2 and a new 1B-parameter driving model.

The notable aspect for PC builders is the open firmware. The repository contains C source for the ASMedia ASM2464PD USB4/Thunderbolt-to-NVMe bridge controller, letting users read and reflash the firmware. This is rare among eGPU enclosures, which typically rely on closed firmware. The firmware allows low-level PCIe TLP access and DMA into the chip’s SRAM, though speeds are modest (about 3.6 MB/s write and 1.8 MB/s read for control messages, up to ~700 MB/s over USB3 for DMA).

Caveats include the bandwidth limitation: Gen4 x4 over USB4 is narrower than a desktop x16 slot, so it won’t deliver full GPU performance. Also, the product is aimed at comma’s driving model users, not general Linux or gaming enthusiasts, though it is compatible with tinygrad workloads. Still, a $249 dock with auditable firmware is an interesting option for those wanting transparency in eGPU hardware.
chinese_title: Chestnut – 搭载开源固件的 eGPU 扩展坞
chinese_summary:
Comma.ai发布了Chestnut，一款搭载开源固件的eGPU扩展坞，主要设计用于在车内运行更大规模的驾驶模型。共有两个版本：Tiny Chestnut售价249美元（仅扩展坞），Chestnut“即驾版”售价799美元，包含一块AMD Radeon RX 9060 8GB显卡、线缆和安装支架。该扩展坞将Comma通常约10W的功耗预算提升至约100W，使得桌面级GPU能够配合comma four设备使用，并宣称可媲美特斯拉HW4的性能。它伴随openpilot 0.11.2和一个新的10亿参数驾驶模型一同发布。

对PC装机爱好者而言，值得注意的点在于其开放固件。代码仓库包含了ASMedia ASM2464PD USB4/ Thunderbolt转NVMe桥接控制器的C语言源码，用户可读取并重刷固件。这在eGPU扩展坞中十分罕见，因为此类产品通常依赖封闭固件。该固件允许底层PCIe TLP访问和对芯片SRAM的DMA操作，不过速度一般（控制消息写入约3.6 MB/s，读取约1.8 MB/s，通过USB3进行DMA时最高约700 MB/s）。

需注意的局限包括带宽限制：USB4的Gen4 x4比桌面x16插槽更窄，因此无法发挥GPU的全部性能。此外，该产品面向Comma的驾驶模型用户，而非普通Linux或游戏爱好者，尽管它兼容tinygrad工作负载。尽管如此，一款售价249美元且固件可审计的扩展坞，对希望eGPU硬件具备透明度的用户来说，仍是个有趣的选择。

title: Tasklet (YC P26) Is Hiring a Head of Design Engineering

title: A SAT Attack on Tarski's High School Algebra Problem
summary:
The article addresses Tarski’s high school algebra problem, which asks whether every true identity about addition, multiplication, and exponentiation over positive integers follows from 11 elementary axioms. Wilkie showed a specific valid identity that does not follow from Tarski’s axioms. Gurevič constructed a 59-element algebra satisfying the axioms but not Wilkie’s identity, and subsequent work reduced this countermodel to size 12. Zhang had established that no countermodel with fewer than 11 elements exists.

Using SAT solvers, the authors prove that 12 is indeed the minimum size of any countermodel, confirming a conjecture by Burris and Yeats. They further show there are exactly 8,957,952 countermodels on 12 elements up to isomorphism and give a simple classification of them. Their SAT-based method outperforms dedicated tools for finding equational-theory countermodels, specifically Mace4 and SEM. Additionally, the authors use autoformalization to verify the correctness of their main result in the Lean proof assistant.

Key contributions:
- Resolution of the minimal countermodel size for Tarski’s high school algebra problem.
- Exact enumeration and classification of all 12-element countermodels.
- Demonstration that SAT solvers can be more effective than specialized model-finding tools.
- Formal verification of the result in Lean via autoformalization.
chinese_title: 用SAT攻克塔尔斯基的高中代数问题
chinese_summary:
本文探讨了塔斯基的高中代数问题，该问题询问：关于正整数上的加法、乘法和幂运算的每个真恒等式，是否都能由11条初等公理推出。威尔基给出了一个特定的有效恒等式，但它不能从塔斯基的公理推出。古列维奇构造了一个满足这些公理但不满足威尔基恒等式的59元代数，随后的工作将这个反模型缩小到12元。张已证明不存在少于11个元素的反模型。

作者利用SAT求解器证明了12确实是最小反模型的规模，证实了伯里斯和耶茨的一个猜想。他们进一步证明，在同构意义下，12元反模型恰好有8,957,952个，并给出了它们的简单分类。他们基于SAT的方法在寻找等式理论反模型方面优于专用工具，特别是Mace4和SEM。此外，作者还使用自动形式化在Lean证明助手中验证了其主要结果的正确性。

主要贡献：
- 解决了塔斯基高中代数问题中最小反模型的规模问题。
- 对所有12元反模型进行了精确枚举和分类。
- 证明了SAT求解器可以比专门的模型查找工具更有效。
- 通过自动形式化在Lean中对结果进行了形式化验证。

title: SIMD in the 90s: Programming Intel's Pentium MMX
summary:
MMX (MultiMedia eXtensions) was Intel’s 1997 introduction of SIMD to mainstream x86 PCs. It added 57 instructions and eight 64-bit registers (MM0–MM7), which aliased the lower 64 bits of the x87 floating-point registers. This saved silicon but meant MMX and x87 FPU code could not coexist; programmers had to use the `EMMS` instruction after MMX work.

MMX operated on packed integers—bytes, words, or dwords—within a single 64-bit register. For example, `paddb` added eight byte values in one instruction. MMX also provided saturating arithmetic (`paddusb`), which clamped results to 0–255, useful for graphics brightness and blending. Comparison instructions produced byte masks (0xFF/0x00), useful for thresholds and transparency. Packed shifts (`psllw`/`psrlw`) offered fast multiply/divide by powers of two, and `pmullw` handled packed 16-bit multiplication for audio scaling, convolution, and fixed-point math—important because MMX had no floating-point SIMD.

SIMD itself predated MMX: the ILLIAC IV and Cray-1 were earlier vector/array processors, but MMX made SIMD accessible to ordinary PC developers. In practice, game adoption was limited because GPUs like the 3dfx Voodoo were emerging, though MMX was used in software texture mapping, alpha blending, MPEG decoding, and audio mixing. Quake’s software renderer predated MMX and relied on other optimizations.

Programs detected MMX via the `CPUID` instruction, checking bit 23 of EDX. AMD later introduced 3DNow! in 1998, using MMX registers for floating-point SIMD, but it saw limited success.
chinese_title: 90年代的SIMD：编程Intel Pentium MMX
chinese_summary:
MMX（MultiMedia eXtensions，多媒体扩展）是英特尔于1997年将SIMD引入主流x86个人电脑的标志。它新增了57条指令和8个64位寄存器（MM0–MM7），这些寄存器与x87浮点寄存器的低64位共享（别名）。这节省了芯片面积，但意味着MMX和x87 FPU代码无法共存；程序员必须在MMX工作后使用`EMMS`指令。

MMX对打包在单个64位寄存器中的整数（字节、字或双字）进行操作。例如，`paddb`一条指令即可完成8个字节值的加法。MMX还提供了饱和运算（`paddusb`），可将结果钳位在0–255范围内，这对图形亮度和混合操作非常有用。比较指令产生字节掩码（0xFF/0x00），适用于阈值判断和透明处理。打包移位（`psllw`/`psrlw`）提供了快速乘以/除以2的幂的运算，而`pmullw`则处理打包的16位乘法，用于音频缩放、卷积和定点数学运算——这很重要，因为MMX没有浮点SIMD。

SIMD本身早于MMX存在：ILLIAC IV和Cray-1是更早的向量/阵列处理器，但MMX使普通PC开发者也能使用SIMD。在实践中，MMX在游戏中的采用有限，因为像3dfx Voodoo这样的GPU正在崛起，不过MMX确实被用于软件纹理映射、Alpha混合、MPEG解码和音频混音。Quake的软件渲染器早于MMX，依赖的是其他优化手段。

程序通过`CPUID`指令检测MMX，检查EDX的第23位。AMD后来于1998年推出了3DNow!，利用MMX寄存器进行浮点SIMD运算，但只取得了有限的成功。

title: The deep history behind the Road to Nowhere inside the Great Smoky Mountains
summary:
The article tells the story of the “Road to Nowhere,” a quarter-mile tunnel in Great Smoky Mountains National Park near Bryson City, North Carolina, that abruptly dead-ends. It was part of a failed road project rooted in the region’s fraught history.

In the early 1900s, Alcoa sought cheap electricity and planned dams on the Little Tennessee River. After the Tennessee Valley Authority took over, the attack on Pearl Harbor pushed Fontana Dam into rapid construction for WWII. The dam created Fontana Lake, but flooded communities and cut off access to ancestral cemeteries. In 1943, TVA and the Department of Interior agreed with Swain County and North Carolina to build a road—Lakeview Drive—so displaced families could reach their cemeteries.

Construction began in the 1960s but stopped in the early 1970s after cutting through Anakeesta rock, which produced acidic runoff and caused environmental damage. The road was never finished, leaving the tunnel as a literal dead end and fueling a sense of “broken promise.” In 2010, the federal government paid Swain County $52 million to settle the dispute.

Despite the unfinished road, descendants have kept their heritage alive. The North Shore Cemetery Association organizes annual Decoration Day visits to cemeteries in the lake’s North Shore area, reached by boat and long hikes. Attendees decorate graves, share meals, sing gospel songs, and pass traditions to younger generations. For many, these difficult journeys have strengthened their connection to ancestral lands and to each other, even as the road itself remains unfinished.
chinese_title: 大烟山“无路之路”背后的深厚历史
chinese_summary:
这篇文章讲述了大烟山国家公园内“无路之路”的故事。这是一条位于北卡罗来纳州布莱森城附近、四分之一英里长的隧道，却突然断头。它原本是一个失败的道路工程的一部分，其根源在于该地区充满伤痛的历史。

20世纪初，美国铝业公司寻求廉价电力，计划在小田纳西河上修建水坝。在田纳西河谷管理局接手后，珍珠港事件促使丰塔纳水坝为二战而急速动工。水坝形成了丰塔纳湖，但也淹没了社区，切断了人们通往祖先墓地的道路。1943年，田纳西河谷管理局和内政部与斯温县及北卡罗来纳州达成协议，修建一条名为“湖景大道”的道路，以便流离失所的家庭能够前往他们的墓地。

道路于20世纪60年代动工，但在70年代初因开挖到阿纳基斯塔岩层而停工——这种岩石产生酸性径流，造成环境破坏。道路始终未能完工，隧道成了一个名副其实的死胡同，也加深了人们的“背弃承诺”之感。2010年，联邦政府向斯温县支付了5200万美元以了结这一争端。

尽管道路未完工，后代们仍将传统传承了下来。北岸公墓协会组织一年一度的“装饰日”活动，乘船并徒步长途跋涉前往湖区北岸地区的墓地祭扫。参与者装饰墓碑、共享餐食、唱福音歌曲，将传统传递给年轻一代。对许多人而言，这些艰难的旅程加深了他们与祖先土地以及彼此之间的纽带，尽管那条路本身仍未完工。

title: GPS and the Lost Art of Getting Lost
summary:
The article explores society’s growing reliance on GPS and what may be lost when we stop navigating on our own. It begins with neuroscientist Shachar Maidenbaum, who encountered GPS spoofing in Israel—fake signals directing him far off course—prompting questions about what happens when GPS fails. GPS was developed by the U.S. military, opened to civilians in 2000, and quickly became ubiquitous. Satellite navigation relies on trilateration from multiple satellites. Historically, getting lost was a significant part of human experience; now, many people outsource spatial reasoning to apps.

Researchers note that GPS encourages “stimulus response” navigation—turn-by-turn directions—rather than “cognitive mapping,” which builds mental models using landmarks. Studies suggest heavy GPS use correlates with poorer spatial memory and reduced attention to surroundings. Examples include truckers who once used paper atlases and pizza delivery workers who needed detailed local knowledge; now they all use GPS. Even a retired park ranger finds he remembers routes less well with digital directions.

The author recounts trying an orienteering course without GPS. Despite the challenge, she felt a pull to check her phone’s blue dot. She ultimately got lost and had to use GPS to find the way back. The experience highlighted the value of practicing attention, patience, and tolerance for uncertainty—skills that atrophy with over-reliance on technology. While GPS is convenient, the article asks whether we lose something essential when we no longer get lost.
chinese_title: GPS与失传的迷路艺术
chinese_summary:
这篇文章探讨了社会对GPS日益增长的依赖，以及当我们不再自行导航时可能失去的东西。文章开头讲述了神经科学家沙查尔·梅登鲍姆的经历，他在以色列遭遇了GPS欺骗——虚假信号将他引向远离目的地的方向——这引发了他对GPS失效时会发生什么的思考。GPS由美国军方开发，2000年向民用开放，并迅速普及。卫星导航依赖于多颗卫星的三边测量。从历史上看，迷路是人类经验的重要组成部分；而现在，许多人将空间推理外包给了应用程序。

研究人员指出，GPS鼓励“刺激-反应”式导航——即逐向转弯的指示——而非“认知地图”式导航，后者通过地标构建心理模型。研究表明，大量使用GPS与空间记忆变差和对周围环境关注度降低相关。例子包括曾经使用纸质地图集的卡车司机，以及曾经需要详细本地知识的披萨配送员；现在他们都使用GPS。甚至一位退休的公园管理员也发现，使用数字导航后他对路线的记忆不如从前。

作者记述了自己在不使用GPS的情况下尝试定向越野的经历。尽管面临挑战，她仍感到一种查看手机蓝点的冲动。她最终迷了路，不得不使用GPS才能找到回去的路。这段经历凸显了练习注意力、耐心和对不确定性的容忍度的价值——这些技能因过度依赖技术而退化。虽然GPS很方便，但文章提出了一个问题：当我们不再迷路时，我们是否失去了某种本质性的东西？

title: Asus Bike Booster
summary:
**ASUS Oxiis Intelligent Bike Booster Summary**

The ASUS Oxiis E250G1 is a universal, friction-drive motor system that converts a conventional bicycle into a smart e-bike. Designed for city, road, gravel, folding, hybrid, and hardtail mountain bikes, it is not compatible with full-suspension models. It features a 250W rated (500W peak) motor with adaptive boost technology that detects inclines, a wireless cadence sensor, and a smart brake-detecting taillight. The unit offers three assist modes (Eco, Sport, etc.) controlled via the unit or the ASUS Oxiis app (Android/iOS).

Key specifications:
- Battery: 158.4 Wh / 36V, charges in 2 hours via 100W USB-C PD (flight-safe with airline approval).
- Range: 10–50 km depending on mode.
- Max speed: 32 km/h (limited to 25 km/h in some regions).
- Weight: 3.7 kg; dimensions: 400 x 84 x 128 mm.
- IPX4 water resistance (splash-proof, not submersible).

The product includes regulatory compliance responsibilities and safety warnings.

title: Research papers using "kidney disappointment" instead of "kidney failure"
summary:
This article is a snapshot of Google Scholar search results showing that some research papers use the phrase **"kidney disappointment"** instead of the correct medical term **"kidney failure"** (or chronic kidney disease). The search returned about 189 results, with several examples:

- A 2024 paper on machine learning for early detection of chronic kidney disease refers to the **"UCI Persistent Kidney Disappointment dataset"**.
- A 2023 paper in *Bionatura* discusses "kidney disappointment" as a condition where kidneys no longer function, distinguishing acute and persistent forms.
- Other papers mention "incessant kidney disappointment," "end-stage kidney disappointment," and complications such as anemia and bone disease.
- Some works use the phrase in nursing care contexts, legal aspects of peritoneal dialysis, and disease overviews.

The related searches at the bottom — **"kidney dissatisfaction"**, **"chronic kidney disease"**, and **"ckd disappointment"** — reinforce the issue. Overall, the article highlights a recurring language/translation error in academic literature, where "failure" is incorrectly rendered as "disappointment," likely due to machine translation or non-native English usage. The result is a confusing but identifiable misuse of terminology across multiple published papers.
chinese_title: 使用“肾脏失望”而非“肾脏衰竭”的研究论文
chinese_summary:
这篇文章是对Google Scholar搜索结果的快照，显示一些研究论文使用了**"kidney disappointment"**（肾脏失望）这一表述，而非正确的医学术语**"kidney failure"**（肾衰竭，或慢性肾脏病）。搜索返回约189条结果，其中有几个例子：

- 一篇2023年发表于*Bionatura*的论文，将"kidney disappointment"讨论为肾脏不再运作的一种状况，并区分了急性和持续性两种形式。
- 其他论文提及"incessant kidney disappointment"（持续不断的肾脏失望）、"end-stage kidney disappointment"（终末期肾脏失望），以及贫血和骨骼疾病等并发症。
- 一些著作在护理场景、腹膜透析的法律层面及疾病概述中使用了这一表述。

底部的相关搜索——**"kidney dissatisfaction"**（肾脏不满）、**"chronic kidney disease"**（慢性肾脏病）和**"ckd disappointment"**（慢性肾病失望）——进一步印证了这一问题。总体而言，这篇文章突显了学术文献中反复出现的语言/翻译错误，即"failure"被错误地译为"disappointment"，很可能是因为机器翻译或非英语母语者的使用所致。其结果是，在多篇已发表的论文中出现了令人困惑但可识别的术语误用。

title: Does anyone run Postgres without PgBouncer?
summary:
The article reflects on a decade-old post about managing Postgres connections, noting that the advice still holds: Postgres struggles with many connections, so a pooler like PgBouncer is essential. To assess how universal pooling has become, the author surveys major managed Postgres providers.

The table shows that nearly all notable providers—including Aiven, AWS RDS (via RDS Proxy), Azure, Crunchy Bridge, DigitalOcean, Google Cloud SQL, Heroku, Neon, Render, Supabase, and more—offer PgBouncer or a similar pooling solution. Only IBM Cloud and OCI lack a managed pooler, but the author dismisses these as enterprise-only. Thus, effectively 100% of plausible managed Postgres providers bundle pooling.

The author argues this status quo represents wasted effort: every provider must build and document its own pooling setup, and users must learn PgBouncer’s limitations (e.g., no LISTEN/NOTIFY) and modes. He uses a car-dealership analogy: buying a car without a windshield is dangerous, but so is selling it that way. Ideally, Postgres would include pooling natively, so users get one URL, one port, and no extra configuration—as is already the case in MySQL and MongoDB worlds.

The reason this doesn’t happen involves the deep “processes versus threads” architectural debate, which few contributors are influential enough to push forward. Still, given the massive developer effort spent working around Postgres’ connection-pooling gap, integrating pooling into the core database would be one of the highest-impact operational improvements possible.
chinese_title: 有人在不使用PgBouncer的情况下运行Postgres吗？
chinese_summary:
这篇文章回顾了十年前一篇关于管理 Postgres 连接的帖子，指出其中的建议至今仍然适用：Postgres 难以应对大量连接，因此像 PgBouncer 这样的连接池化工具至关重要。为了评估连接池化已变得多么普遍，作者调查了主要的托管 Postgres 提供商。

表格显示，几乎所有知名的提供商——包括 Aiven、AWS RDS（通过 RDS Proxy）、Azure、Crunchy Bridge、DigitalOcean、Google Cloud SQL、Heroku、Neon、Render、Supabase 等——都提供 PgBouncer 或类似的连接池化解决方案。只有 IBM Cloud 和 OCI 缺乏托管连接池化工具，但作者认为这些仅面向企业用户而不予考虑。因此，实际上 100% 可行的托管 Postgres 提供商都捆绑了连接池化功能。

作者认为这种现状代表了精力的浪费：每个提供商都必须构建并文档化自己的连接池化设置，用户也必须了解 PgBouncer 的局限性（例如，不支持 LISTEN/NOTIFY）及其运行模式。他用了一个汽车经销商的类比：买一辆没有挡风玻璃的汽车是危险的，但以这种方式出售汽车同样是问题。理想情况下，Postgres 应该原生包含连接池化功能，这样用户只需一个 URL、一个端口，无需额外配置——正如 MySQL 和 MongoDB 世界早已实现的那样。

之所以没有实现这一点，涉及深层的“进程与线程”架构之争，而很少有贡献者具有足够的影响力来推动这一变革。尽管如此，鉴于开发者在规避 Postgres 连接池化缺陷上投入的巨大精力，将连接池化集成到数据库核心中，将是最具影响力的运维改进之一。

title: Asynchronous I/O in DuckDB: Work, Thread, Work
summary:
DuckDB is introducing asynchronous I/O for Parquet and CSV reads in v2.0 (fall 2026), designed for remote storage like S3 where synchronous reads underutilize network bandwidth. The system uses two thread pools: regular workers for compute, and many async threads (default 4× cores, cap 256) for blocking I/O. A read-ahead queue prefetches fetch tasks (e.g., Parquet row groups, CSV buffers) to hide latency, while memory governance via `read_ahead_depth` (default -1, bounded by temporary memory manager) prevents out-of-memory issues. When workers need data, they claim oldest queue jobs; if I/O is incomplete, they park and run other tasks—fetch tasks later unblock them.

Benchmarks on TPC-H Q6 SF100 stored on S3 (EC2 64 vCPU, 25 Gbit/s network): asynchronous I/O cut runtime from 8.23s (v1.5.5) to 2.844s (~3×); tuned settings (48 async threads, retries) reached 2.227s (~3.7×). Network throughput jumped from ~5 Gbit/s to near saturation. On cold local SSD (MacBook M4 Max), runtime improved from 1.321s to 0.883s (~1.5×); hot reads show negligible difference. With 976 small Parquet files, async I/O was ~3× faster (9.34s → 2.94s). Testing varied row-group sizes showed optimal parallelism when enough row groups exist; extremely large row groups (e.g., 12.3 GB single group) hurt performance due to reduced parallelism. Overall, async I/O dramatically improves remote data scans while also helping cold local reads.
chinese_title: DuckDB中的异步I/O：工作，线程，工作
chinese_summary:
DuckDB 正在 v2.0（2026 年秋季）中为 Parquet 和 CSV 读取引入异步 I/O，专为 S3 等远程存储设计，因为在这些场景下同步读取无法充分利用网络带宽。该系统使用两个线程池：常规工作线程负责计算，大量异步线程（默认为核心数的 4 倍，上限 256）负责阻塞式 I/O。预读队列会预取抓取任务（例如 Parquet 行组、CSV 缓冲区）以隐藏延迟，同时通过 `read_ahead_depth`（默认 -1，受临时内存管理器约束）进行内存治理，防止内存溢出问题。当工作线程需要数据时，它们会认领队列中最旧的作业；如果 I/O 未完成，它们会挂起并运行其他任务——抓取任务随后会解除它们的阻塞。

在存储于 S3 的 TPC-H Q6 SF100 基准测试中（EC2 64 vCPU，25 Gbit/s 网络）：异步 I/O 将运行时间从 8.23 秒（v1.5.5）缩短至 2.844 秒（约 3 倍）；调优设置（48 个异步线程，启用重试）达到 2.227 秒（约 3.7 倍）。网络吞吐量从约 5 Gbit/s 跃升至接近饱和。在冷本地 SSD（MacBook M4 Max）上，运行时间从 1.321 秒改善至 0.883 秒（约 1.5 倍）；热读取的差异可忽略不计。使用 976 个小 Parquet 文件时，异步 I/O 快约 3 倍（9.34 秒 → 2.94 秒）。对不同行组大小的测试表明，当存在足够多的行组时并行性最佳；极大的行组（例如单个 12.3 GB 行组）会因并行度降低而损害性能。总体而言，异步 I/O 显著改善了远程数据扫描，同时也对冷本地读取有帮助。

title: Superconducting monolayer cuprate with a single CuO2 plane
summary:
A study on superconducting monolayer cuprates reports the fabrication and investigation of a single layer of Bi₂Sr₂CuO₆₊δ (Bi-2201), which contains only one CuO₂ plane—the ultimate two-dimensional limit for cuprate superconductors. The authors find a robust dimensionality effect: the optimal superconducting transition temperature is reduced by approximately 10% compared with thicker samples, showing that even a single CuO₂ plane can host superconductivity.

Using finely controlled oxygenation of monolayer specimens, they extended the Bi-2201 phase diagram into previously inaccessible regions. This tunability allowed them to observe a superconductor-to-insulator transition (SIT) as temperature approaches zero, with an anomalous metallic state emerging between the insulating and superconducting phases. Finite-size scaling analysis of the SIT reveals anomalous scaling behavior with a divergent critical exponent, indicating unconventional quantum criticality.

The findings highlight the impact of reduced dimensionality on cuprate superconductivity and provide new insight into the nature of the quantum phase transition between superconducting and insulating states in high-temperature superconductors.
chinese_title: 具有单个CuO2面的超导单层铜氧化物
chinese_summary:
一项关于超导单层铜氧化物的研究报告了一种单层Bi₂Sr₂CuO₆₊δ（Bi-2201）的制备与研究，该单层仅包含一个CuO₂面，这是铜氧化物超导体在二维极限下的最终形态。作者发现了一种显著的维度效应：与较厚样品相比，最佳超导转变温度降低了约10%，这表明即使单个CuO₂面也能承载超导性。

通过对单层样品进行精细控制的氧化处理，他们将Bi-2201的相图扩展到了此前无法触及的区域。这种可调性使他们能够观察到温度趋近于零时的超导体-绝缘体转变（SIT），且在绝缘相与超导相之间出现了一种反常金属态。对SIT的有限尺寸标度分析揭示了具有发散临界指数的反常标度行为，表明存在非传统的量子临界性。

这些发现突显了维度降低对铜氧化物超导电性的影响，并为高温超导体中超导态与绝缘态之间量子相变的本质提供了新的见解。

title: Show HN: A public AI whose memory is shared across all users
summary: This project introduces a "public AI" that operates as a single, unified entity with a memory shared by all users. Instead of each person having a separate, isolated interaction with an AI, everyone talks to the same one instance. This shared memory means that experiences, events, and information are accumulated collectively over time, creating a common pool of knowledge that every user can access and contribute to. Key features include a timeline of the AI's daily experiences and an updates feed. Essentially, it's a communal, persistent AI consciousness where the history and interactions of all users merge into one continuous, public narrative.

chinese_summary: 这个项目引入了一种“公共AI”，它作为一个单一、统一的实体运行，拥有所有用户共享的记忆。不是每个人与AI进行各自独立的交互，而是所有人都与同一个实例对话。这种共享记忆意味着经验、事件和信息会随着时间集体积累，形成一个所有用户都可以访问并为之贡献的共同知识库。主要功能包括AI日常经历的时间线和更新动态。本质上，这是一种公共的、持久的AI意识，所有用户的历史和交互都融合成一个连续的、公开的叙事。

title: Cultivating a state of mind where new ideas are born (2023)
summary:
The article argues that groundbreaking creativity requires cultivating a solitary mental state, not merely physical alone time. This state protects fragile early ideas from social ridicule and allows deep engagement with one’s own thoughts. The authors use Alexander Grothendieck and Ingmar Bergman’s working notes to illustrate.

Key points:
- Startup coworking spaces failed because great ideas are fragile; social pressure kills them. Sam Altman notes Y Combinator intentionally avoids shared spaces.
- Artists echo this: Picasso, Baldwin, and Dylan all emphasize solitude.
- Grothendieck’s early years in isolation at Montpellier, where he unknowingly reinvented known mathematics, taught him “the capacity to be alone.” This gave him confidence and access to original questions, unlike brilliant peers who stayed within established frameworks.
- Creative individuals are willing to linger in confusion and seek new questions rather than merely answer existing ones.
- Solitude must be balanced with engaging others, but only after one knows their own genuine curiosity, so they don’t lose themselves to social influence.

The core lesson: to produce truly new work, one must develop an inner space free from external judgment, where fragile ideas can grow.
chinese_title: 培育新思想诞生的心境（2023）
chinese_summary:
本文认为，突破性的创造力需要培养一种独处的精神状态，而不仅仅是物理上的独处时间。这种状态能保护脆弱的早期想法免受他人的嘲笑，并允许人们深度沉浸于自己的思考中。作者以亚历山大·格罗滕迪克和英格玛·伯格曼的工作笔记为例加以说明。

要点如下：
- 创业联合办公空间之所以失败，是因为伟大的想法是脆弱的；社会压力会扼杀它们。山姆·奥特曼指出，Y Combinator 刻意避免共享空间。
- 艺术家们也有同感：毕加索、鲍德温和迪伦都强调独处的重要性。
- 格罗滕迪克在蒙彼利埃早期的孤立时光中，无意间重新发明了已知的数学，这教会了他“独处的能力”。这赋予了他自信和接触原创性问题的途径，而那些才华横溢的同行们却停留在既定的框架内。
- 具有创造力的人愿意在困惑中徘徊，并寻求新的问题，而不仅仅是回答现有的问题。
- 独处必须与与他人互动取得平衡，但必须是在自己了解真正的好奇心之后，这样才不会在社交影响中迷失自我。

核心启示：要创作出真正全新的作品，一个人必须发展出一个不受外界评判的内心空间，让脆弱的想法在其中成长。

title: Super El Niño Keeps Growing as New Forecasts Reach Record Territory Ahead Winter
summary:
A rapidly intensifying Super El Niño is underway for 2026/27, with forecasts repeatedly revised upward into record territory. Its swift growth is driven by record-strength westerly wind bursts across the equatorial Pacific and a powerful subsurface Kelvin Wave carrying anomalously warm water eastward. Ocean surface temperatures exceed 5–6°C above normal in the eastern tropical Pacific, while subsurface anomalies reach over 9°C. The event has already surpassed the 2015–16 Super El Niño in speed and strength.

June–July westerly wind anomalies were the strongest in an 86-year record, signaling a sustained collapse of trade winds. Forecast models, including ECMWF and NMME, now project peak anomalies near +4°C—far above the +2°C Super El Niño threshold and into unofficial extreme territory, likely peaking around November–December.

The atmosphere is already responding: a stationary Walker circulation pattern has formed, and NOAA’s Multivariate ENSO Index hit a record +2.4 for June–July, the highest for that period since 1979. This indicates unusually strong ocean-atmosphere coupling.

Fall 2026 forecasts show an early El Niño winter pattern: high pressure over Canada, low pressure and a storm track across the southern U.S., and a North Atlantic low affecting the UK and Ireland. This implies warmer conditions across northern U.S. and Canada, while southern regions face active storms. The article emphasizes that a historic Super El Niño is unfolding, with likely major seasonal impacts across North America and Europe in late 2026 and winter 2026/27.
chinese_title: 超级厄尔尼诺持续增强 新预测在入冬前达到创纪录水平
chinese_summary:
一场快速增强的超强厄尔尼诺事件正在形成，影响2026/27年，预报多次上调至创纪录水平。其迅速增强由赤道太平洋上空创纪录强度的西风爆发和一股携带异常暖水东移的强大次表层开尔文波所驱动。热带东太平洋海表温度较常年偏高5–6°C以上，次表层异常超过9°C。此次事件在速度和强度上已超过2015–16年超强厄尔尼诺。

6–7月的西风异常为86年来最强，标志着信风的持续崩溃。包括ECMWF和NMME在内的预报模型现在预计峰值异常接近+4°C——远高于+2°C的超强厄尔尼诺阈值，进入非官方的极端区间，峰值可能出现在11–12月左右。

大气已开始响应：一个准静止的沃克环流模式已经形成，NOAA的多变量ENSO指数在6–7月达到创纪录的+2.4，为1979年以来同期最高。这表明海气耦合异常强烈。

2026年秋季预报显示，厄尔尼诺冬季模式提前出现：加拿大上空为高压，美国南部为低压并伴有风暴路径，北大西洋低压影响英国和爱尔兰。这意味着美国北部和加拿大气温偏高，而南部地区将面临活跃风暴。文章强调，历史性的超强厄尔尼诺正在展开，可能在2026年末和2026/27年冬季对北美和欧洲产生重大季节影响。

title: Nvidia discloses $21B stake in SpaceX at end of second quarter
summary:
Nvidia disclosed a roughly $21 billion stake in Elon Musk’s SpaceX at the end of the second quarter. The chipmaker owns 122.8 million Class A shares, acquired through its $10 billion investment in Musk’s xAI, which SpaceX acquired in February. SpaceX went public in June, and its stock has since fallen from $170.86 at the end of June to $140, putting Nvidia’s stake at about $17.2 billion.

The holding is Nvidia’s second-largest, behind its Intel stake—currently worth about $22 billion, down from $30 billion at quarter-end. Nvidia’s $5 billion investment in less than a year has still generated a large return. Based on FactSet data, Nvidia is SpaceX’s sixth-largest investor; Musk is by far the largest, with a stake worth about $850 billion, followed by Alphabet at roughly $78 billion.

On SpaceX’s second-quarter earnings call, Musk said the company will exclusively use Nvidia chips in its AI data centers, citing Nvidia’s GPUs as having the “best architecture” for AI training and inference. He also said SpaceX expects a “significant allocation” of Nvidia’s Vera Rubin GPUs next year.

title: Guiding Ships with Moire Patterns (2018)
summary:
The article describes the author’s hands-on exploration of a Moiré-pattern navigation system used to guide ships, inspired by Tom Scott’s video. The system, based on an “Inogon” light and patent US4629325, uses two overlaid grids to create a visual steering beam. The author built a working model using Inkscape and a laser cutter, following the patent’s recommended pitch-to-dark-band ratio of 1.5–1.8 (using 1.65) and a single excess band on one mask.

Illuminated from behind and viewed head-on, the device shows the intended Moiré effect. From different angles, the pattern shifts, giving clear directional guidance. The author is impressed: it is intuitive, requires little calibration, and multiple users can view it simultaneously.

However, he questions its practical superiority. Harbours usually have a safe corridor rather than a razor-thin path, and the Moiré system gives steering corrections even when the ship is safely inside the channel. He compares it to a simpler three-light system seen in Newcastle: if the top lamp is between the two lower ones, the ship is on course; if above one, it’s at the edge; if outside both, the ship is off the path. For a pilot dealing with currents, weather, and traffic, the three-lamp system may be better because it only warns when there is actual danger, avoiding unnecessary fuel use and concentration demands.

Still, the Moiré system is “super cool” and well-suited for marking narrow objects, such as a submarine cable, where precise alignment matters. The author shared his design files on Thingiverse for anyone interested in making their own.
chinese_title: 摩尔纹导引船舶（2018）
chinese_summary:
文章描述了作者对一种用于引导船舶的摩尔纹图案导航系统的亲身探索，其灵感来自汤姆·斯科特的视频。该系统基于“Inogon”灯和专利US4629325，利用两层叠加的网格产生视觉转向光束。作者按照专利推荐的节距与暗带比为1.5–1.8（取1.65）以及一个掩模上多一条条纹带的设计，使用Inkscape和激光切割机制作了一个工作模型。

从背后照明并正面观看时，该装置呈现出预期的摩尔纹效果。从不同角度观察，图案会发生偏移，从而提供清晰的定向引导。作者对此印象深刻：它直观易懂，几乎不需要校准，而且多人可以同时观看。

然而，他对其实用优越性提出了质疑。港口通常有安全走廊而非一条极窄的通道，而摩尔纹系统即使在船只安全处于航道内时也会给出转向修正。他将其与在纽卡斯尔看到的一种更简单的三灯系统进行对比：如果顶部灯位于两个下部灯之间，则船在航道上；如果偏向其中一个灯上方，则船在航道边缘；如果超出两者之外，则船已偏离航道。对于需要应对水流、天气和交通状况的引航员来说，三灯系统可能更好，因为它只在存在实际危险时才发出警告，避免了不必要的燃油消耗和注意力要求。

尽管如此，摩尔纹系统“超酷”，非常适合标记需要精确对准的狭窄目标物，例如海底电缆。作者已在Thingiverse上分享了设计文件，供有兴趣的人自行制作。

title: Treasury Orders Erasure of Domestic Ownership Records
summary:
The U.S. Treasury’s Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) issued a final rule on August 11, 2026, effective August 14, 2026, permanently ending the requirement for U.S. companies and U.S. persons to report beneficial ownership information under the Corporate Transparency Act. FinCEN will also delete previously reported information from the database for individuals now exempt.

Key provisions include:
- Making permanent the exemptions from the March 2025 interim final rule.
- Exempting U.S. persons with FinCEN IDs from updating or correcting previously submitted information.
- Eliminating the requirement for foreign companies to report U.S. person “company applicants.”
- Exempting foreign pooled investment vehicles registered in the U.S. from reporting U.S. persons in control.
- Deleting information about individuals FinCEN reasonably believes are U.S. persons, such as those linked to U.S. passports or driver’s licenses.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent called the move “a victory for common sense and American small businesses,” saying it cuts red tape without compromising national security. Foreign entities that are reporting companies must still report beneficial ownership information for foreign individuals. FinCEN also issued FAQs and updated guidance on its website.
chinese_title: 财政部下令删除国内所有权记录
chinese_summary:
美国财政部金融犯罪执法网络（FinCEN）于2026年8月11日发布最终规则，自2026年8月14日起生效，永久终止美国公司和美国人根据《企业透明度法案》报告受益所有权信息的要求。FinCEN还将从数据库中删除现已豁免个人的先前报告信息。

主要内容包括：
- 使2025年3月临时最终规则中的豁免条款永久化。
- 豁免持有FinCEN ID的美国人对先前提交信息进行更新或更正的要求。
- 取消外国公司报告美国人“公司申请人”的要求。
- 豁免在美国注册的外国集合投资工具报告控制权美国人。
- 删除FinCEN合理认定为美国人的个人相关信息，例如与美国护照或驾照相关的信息。

财政部长斯科特·贝森特称此举是“常识和美国小企业的胜利”，表示这在不损害国家安全的前提下削减了繁文缛节。作为报告公司的外国实体仍须报告外国个人的受益所有权信息。FinCEN还在其网站上发布了常见问题解答和更新后的指南。

title: At-home test for infected ticks could improve Lyme Disease diagnosis
summary:
The article highlights the growing threat of tick-borne illnesses in the U.S., especially Lyme disease, and introduces a new at-home tick-testing product called LymeAlert.

Key points:

- Each year, over 31 million Americans experience a tick bite. Lyme disease is the most common tick-borne illness, with about 476,000 patients treated annually, mostly in the Northeast, Mid-Atlantic, and Upper Midwest.
- Early treatment is critical, but current methods have gaps: blood tests within 30 days of a bite miss 64–78% of early cases because antibodies haven’t developed yet. Mail-in tick tests often return results after the CDC’s recommended 72-hour prophylactic antibiotic window closes.
- LymeAlert, developed by pediatric physician associate Erin Dawicki and co-founders Michelle Ewy and Brenda Ong, is an at-home test that detects *Borrelia burgdorferi*—the bacterium causing Lyme disease—directly in the tick.
- The kit costs about $50. Users crush the tick with a “Tick Crusher,” add a buffer solution, and insert a test strip. In about 15 minutes, two lines mean the tick is infected; one line means it is not. It works like a pregnancy or COVID test.
- A companion app can read the test results for users and connect them to telehealth providers if needed.
- The test is designed to give rapid answers within the critical 72-hour window, helping people decide whether to seek prophylactic antibiotics.
- Experts note that tick ranges are expanding due to warmer winters, deer and mouse populations, deforestation, and urban sprawl. However, not all ticks carry Lyme disease; infection depends on what the tick fed on in its earlier life stage.
chinese_title: 居家检测受感染蜱虫或可提高莱姆病诊断准确性
chinese_summary:
这篇文章重点阐述了美国蜱传疾病日益严重的威胁，尤其是莱姆病，并介绍了一款名为LymeAlert的新型家用蜱虫检测产品。

要点如下：

- 每年有超过3100万美国人被蜱虫叮咬。莱姆病是最常见的蜱传疾病，每年约有47.6万名患者接受治疗，主要集中在东北部、中大西洋地区和上中西部地区。
- 早期治疗至关重要，但目前的方法存在缺口：被叮咬后30天内进行血液检测会漏掉64%至78%的早期病例，因为此时抗体尚未产生。邮寄蜱虫检测往往在CDC建议的72小时预防性抗生素用药窗口关闭后才出结果。
- LymeAlert由儿科医师助理Erin Dawicki与联合创始人Michelle Ewy和Brenda Ong共同开发，是一款可直接检测蜱虫体内导致莱姆病的伯氏疏螺旋体（*Borrelia burgdorferi*）的家用检测产品。
- 该检测套装售价约50美元。用户用“蜱虫粉碎器”将蜱虫压碎，加入缓冲液，然后插入试纸条。约15分钟后，出现两条线表示蜱虫已感染；一条线则表示未感染。其原理类似验孕棒或新冠检测试剂。
- 配套手机应用可读取用户的检测结果，如有需要还可连接远程医疗服务提供者。
- 该检测旨在72小时关键窗口期内快速给出结果，帮助人们决定是否需要寻求预防性抗生素治疗。

title: Falstad Math and Physics Simulations
summary:
This article describes Paul Falstad’s collection of educational math, physics, and engineering applets, originally written in Java but mostly converted to JavaScript for browser use. The applets are interactive visualizations covering a wide range of topics:

- **Oscillations and Waves**: Ripple tank, 2-D/3-D waves, coupled oscillations, dispersion.
- **Acoustics**: Vibrating strings, membranes, bars, speech vowels, box modes, acoustic interference.
- **Signal Processing**: Fourier series, digital filters.
- **Electricity and Magnetism**: Electrostatic and magnetostatic fields, motors/generators, circuit simulators, waveguides, antennas, Fresnel diffraction, Fermat’s principle.
- **Quantum Mechanics**: Hydrogen atom orbitals, molecular orbitals, 1-D/2-D/3-D quantum systems, harmonic oscillators, rigid rotator, radiative transitions.
- **Linear Algebra and Vector Calculus**: Dot product, matrix transformations, 2-D/3-D vector fields.
- **Thermodynamics**: Gas molecule kinetic theory, heat engines and Carnot cycles.
- **Mechanics**: Harmonic oscillator, Coriolis force, Foucault pendulum, orbital rendezvous, Lagrange points, symmetrical top.
- **Miscellaneous**: ODE solver, Euler’s equation, discrete Fourier transform, ray optics simulator, thermal camera images.

The page also includes links to many external educational resources, such as PhET, Physlets, MyPhysicsLab, and circuit diagram tools, as well as some “fun” items like a Pong simulation and a maze applet. Licensing information and contributor credits are noted. Overall, the collection serves as a broad, hands-on resource for visualizing concepts across physics, math, and engineering.

title: A fortuitous decade as an indie software developer
summary:
The author reflects on ten years as an indie software developer, starting when he quit his job on August 9, 2016. He had no plan and initially struggled financially for five years, depleting his savings and feeling hopeless. He attributes his eventual success to luck and an inability to find a new job—his age, lack of a computer science degree, and outdated Mac/Objective-C skills made him unemployable. He avoids giving business advice due to survivorship bias.

His first app, Underpass, was a peer-to-peer encrypted chat and file transfer tool, released in 2017. It failed, earning under $3,000, and was removed from the App Store in 2021, though he still uses it personally. He chose App Store exclusivity because iOS required it and because he lacked confidence in the business, viewing the app as résumé material.

His second app, StopTheMadness, a Safari extension inspired by a tweet, became moderately popular but not profitable enough. When Apple released iOS 15 in September 2021 with Safari web browser extension support, StopTheMadness took off. That moment, just as he was about to go broke, changed his career. StopTheMadness now accounts for over 93% of his lifetime App Store revenue. He describes himself as a one-hit wonder, happy to keep improving it.

Looking ahead, he makes few long-term plans, preferring to “ride the waves” like a surfer. His only major paid upgrade, StopTheMadness Pro, succeeded, but he remains uncertain about the next decade.

展望未来，他很少做长远计划，更愿意像冲浪者一样“随波逐流”。他唯一一次重要的付费升级StopTheMadness Pro取得了成功，但他对下一个十年仍不确定。

title: Software Engineering fundamentals matter more
summary: The article argues that while agentic AI tools (LLMs) are powerful, the core fundamentals of software engineering—designing testable, maintainable, debuggable, and composable systems—matter more than ever. The author acknowledges the hype around agentic engineering but notes that "can it be done" is only the starting point; how software fits together, its seams and interfaces, is what truly determines quality. LLMs don't reason—they predict, echoing compressed human knowledge—and current models fall short on extensive reasoned judgment. Risks include Simon Willison's "lethal trifecta": LLMs can't distinguish good advice from bad and are vulnerable to prompt injection. To use them effectively, engineers should provide concise data at the right time and pair agents with deterministic validation tools and natural-language feedback. The author hopes future training will include reasoning traces that reinforce clean interfaces, debuggability, and maintainability. Ultimately, software engineering remains about tradeoffs, choosing the right abstractions, and managing cognitive load—skills humans must deliberately apply whether or not they use agentic assistants.
chinese_title: 软件工程基础更加重要
chinese_summary: 这篇文章认为，尽管智能体AI工具（LLM）功能强大，但软件工程的核心基础——设计可测试、可维护、可调试和可组合的系统——比以往任何时候都更加重要。作者承认智能体工程存在大量炒作，但指出“能否做到”只是起点；软件各部分如何组合、其接缝和接口，才是真正决定质量的关键。LLM并不会推理——它们只是预测，压缩了人类知识的回声——而当前模型在广泛的理性判断方面仍有不足。风险包括西蒙·威利森的“致命三重奏”：LLM无法区分好的建议和坏的建议，且容易受到提示注入攻击。要有效使用它们，工程师应在恰当的时机提供简洁的数据，并将智能体与确定性验证工具和自然语言反馈配对使用。作者希望未来的训练能包含推理轨迹，以强化清晰的接口、可调试性和可维护性。归根结底，软件工程仍然关乎权衡取舍、选择正确的抽象以及管理认知负荷——无论是否使用智能体助手，这些都是人类必须有意识地运用的技能。
